guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Dick Dale is famously associated with a left-handed (strung normally, played upside down) Fender Stratocaster nicknamed "The Beast," central to surf rock history.
guitar.notes: Well-documented, iconic gear association — should not have been unknown.

tone.target: bright surf twang with huge spring reverb and fast tremolo
tone.profile: bright surf twang with huge spring reverb and fast tremolo
tone.summary: A classic surf rock chain utilizing a clean pre-amp (Green OD/Boost), followed by an AC30 TB or US Deluxe for the core tone, paired with a Spring Reverb and Tremolo to achieve the signature bright twang.
corrections: drop E minor; tune is not the target
replace fuzz/crunch with clean edge-breakup twang
make tremolo and spring reverb dominant

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide a bright, slightly overdriven clean edge-breakup tone suitable for twang.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate the slight grit of an old Fender amp without heavy distortion.

alternatives.reason: A clean boost could also achieve the necessary lift.

blocks.purpose: Bypass (or use a very subtle drive if needed). The Green OD handles the necessary grit.
blocks.gap: No dedicated distortion unit is required; the clean edge-breakup comes from the PRE stage and amp choice.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, articulate sound of a classic Fender-style amplifier.
blocks.gap: While AC30 is British, its clean voicing and brightness are often used in surf rock contexts to achieve high clarity. US Deluxe would be an alternative.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright, focused cabinet sound matching the single-coil twang.
Implement the signature fast tremolo effect.
Crucial element for the surf sound; provides the characteristic spring tank echo.
Add subtle rhythmic depth and space without muddying the bright tone.
blocks.gap: Optional, but useful for filling out the soundscape slightly beyond just reverb/tremolo.

blocks.purpose: Brighten the high end and cut unnecessary low-end mud.
blocks.gap: Fine-tuning the frequency response to emphasize 'twang'.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the bright, articulate single-coil twang of surf rock.

proposals.reason: Enhance clarity and vintage character for the single-coil twang.
